map.为什么纵向比横向强？: Why is longitudinal strength greater than transverse?
map.纵向纤维承力（等应变、算术平均高），横向靠基体传力（等应力、调和平均低），故复合: Longitudinally the fibres carry the load (equal strain, a high arithmetic average), while transversely the matrix transfers the load (equal stress, a low harmonic average), so composites are strongly anisotropic.
map.混合法则是精确吗？: Is the rule of mixtures exact?
